DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Their Pillar of Frost is active, as this directly amplifies their core damage window.
  • They activate Breath of Sindragosa, provided they can sustain the ability’s resource cost for multiplicative scaling.
  • Empower Rune Weapon is used, aligning haste benefits with maximum rune regeneration.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They’re in a single-target or multi-target scenario, and any of the following are met:
  • Summon Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining on its duration.
  • Using Army of the Dead (without Gargoyle), and Raise Abomination is active with ≤18 seconds remaining or Army ghouls are active with ≤18 seconds remaining.
  • Not using Summon Gargoyle or Army of the Dead, and Dark Transformation is active.
  • They’re not using Summon Gargoyle, and Gargoyle’s cooldown +10 seconds exceeds Power Infusion’s duration.
  • There are ≥3 active enemies and Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is active on the ground.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They activate Metamorphosis, their primary offensive cooldown, to maximize its damage window.
  • The boss has less 20 seconds remaining in the fight, ensuring full value from the cooldown.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Cooldown alignment conditions are met and they do not have the TWW3 Keeper 4pc tier set active.
  • TWW3 Keeper 4pc tier set is active and their Kindred of the Grove (KotG) or Celestial Alignment (CA) timing conditions are fulfilled.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Druid has Bloodtalons active (via the Incarnation buff) to amplify their high-damage ability window
  • The Druid does NOT have Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent selected, indicating they're using a build requiring external cooldown support during burst phases
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • They activate Dragonrage and either: their Shattering Star is on cooldown, their target has the Shattering Star debuff, or there are 2+ active enemies.
  • The fight will end in under 35 seconds (to avoid wasting the cooldown).
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • Their Trueshot cooldown has over 12 seconds remaining to maximize burst damage during their strongest window.
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds to ensure full utilization before the fight concludes.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Their Coordinated Assault is active with more than 7 seconds remaining and they don't already have Power Infusion.
  • They do not have Coordinated Assault talented and have already used Spearhead (it's on cooldown).
  • They have neither Coordinated Assault nor Spearhead talented in their current build.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • the Arcane Mage has just cast Arcane Surge as their previous global cooldown.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion isn't active on them,
  • and either: their Combustion has more than 6 seconds remaining, or the fight ends in under 25 seconds.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • The Frost Mage does not have Power Infusion active and it is available to cast.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • They have Xuen the White Tiger active and Bloodlust/heroism is not active.
  • They have Xuen the White Tiger active during Bloodlust/heroism, but only if Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown (to avoid overlapping burst windows).
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • the Retribution Paladin has Avenging Wrath active
  • the Retribution Paladin has Crusade active
  • the target is affected by the Retribution Paladin’s Execution Sentence debuff
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • They are in Voidform and Power Infusion isn’t active.
  • They activate Dark Ascension and Power Infusion isn’t active.
  • They have the The War Within 2-piece tier set bonus and Power Infusion isn’t active.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • They have Deathmark active on the target, as this aligns with their major damage amplification window and maximum bleed uptime.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They activate Shadow Dance, as this aligns with their burst window to amplify damage from stealth-enhanced abilities.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • They are actively under the effect of Ascendance to amplify their empowered burst damage.
  • Ascendance is unavailable and its cooldown exceeds 30 seconds remaining, ensuring optimal timing for future cycles.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • They have Deeply Rooted Elements talented and their Ascendance buff has over 7.5 seconds remaining.
  • They activate any major cooldown: Ascendance is active, Feral Spirit is summoned, or Doom Winds is active (without Deeply Rooted Elements talented).
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds and Power Infusion can be fully utilized before combat concludes.
  • Their shortest remaining cooldown among key talents is 120 seconds or longer, allowing maximum benefit from Power Infusion.
  • They haven’t talented Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds, requiring a neutral timing window.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • Soul Rot is active on the target or the warlock is in a major cooldown window (e.g., with summoning Darkglare).
  • They activate multiple offensive cooldowns simultaneously, aligning burst phases with the damage amplification window.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • The Warlock is about to trigger Imp Gang Boss imps' despawn (via Summon Demonic Tyrant)
  • There are fewer than 6 seconds remaining before those imps naturally expire (calculated as 6 Global Cooldowns plus 1 cast time remaining)
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Their Summon Infernal is currently active.
  • They are not using the Summon Infernal talent.
  • The encounter will end before their next Summon Infernal cooldown and lasts long enough to benefit from the full Power Infusion duration.
  • The remaining fight time is shorter than Summon Infernal's cooldown + 15 seconds.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • Colossus Smash is active on the target and the encounter will last 135+ seconds remaining
  • They are in Execute phase (sub-20% target health) and Avatar is active
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds (final burn phase)
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has over 15 seconds remaining and the fight will last at least 135 more seconds
  • The fight is in the execute phase (enemies below 20% health) while Avatar is active
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds or less
